payload.reason: The evidence provides clear methods for segmenting text, particularly in the context of lengthy legal documents, and explains how these segments are processed to improve classification results.

claims.text: Text is segmented into smaller chunks to encapsulate context and improve processing results.
Dividing text into segments and combining embeddings with a BiLSTM architecture enhances classification outcomes.
Document segmentation mimics human reading behavior by allowing the machine to identify and determine the relevance of each chunk.
Different models are created based on the number of chunks to observe their effect on model efficiency.
